name: bug
description: Confirmed defect where code violates its documented contract or invariant

name: error
description: Hard runtime, build, verification, or proof-checker failure

name: issue
description: Functional or UX misbehavior needing remediation

name: problem
description: Structural, legal, epistemic, or architectural defect

name: concern
description: Risk or fragility that may fail under future scaling or changes

name: dilemma
description: Engineering tradeoff without a dominant solution (e.g. PCIe vs CPU at 1M)

name: conflict
description: Tension between two standards, laws, or platform constraints

name: gap
description: Missing test, proof, documentation, or verification coverage

name: hole
description: Bypassable guard or incomplete boundary check

name: blindspot
description: Unexamined assumption, stale metric, or overlooked failure mode

name: performance
description: Bare-metal throughput, SIMD, and GPU benchmarks
